BUCKET.INSERT.summary: Inserts one or more documents into a bucket.
BUCKET.INSERT.complexity: O(N*M) where N is the number of documents and M is the number of indexes on the bucket.

reply_schema.description: The id of every inserted document, in the order the documents were given.

items.description: A document id. The encoding follows the session's object_id_format attribute: 12 raw bytes or 24 hex characters.

arguments.name: bucket
arguments.summary: The name of the bucket to insert into.

arguments.name: document
arguments.summary: One or more documents, each encoded as BSON bytes or a JSON string.
